text: {"distance_m": 7, "reasoning_short": "A 30% contrast spot is below the high-contrast 1 arcmin acuity limit. Using Ricco's law (threshold contrast × area ≈ constant) with Blackwell-type indoor thresholds of about 100% contrast at 1 arcmin, it needs about 1.8–2 arcmin (≈5.5e-4 rad). Then 4 mm / 5.5e-4 rad ≈ 7 m, a rough estimate since the threshold data are approximate."}
